name: Avenkin
subtitle: Talk. Ask. Get things done.
promotionalText: Put your voice to work with Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, Music, Home and Shortcuts. Start with Siri or the Action Button, and choose the AI that works for you.
description:
Your AI. Your terms.

Go from a question to an action on your iPhone or iPad. Avenkin connects conversational AI with the Apple apps you use every day. Talk through your phone or headphones, type a question, or bring a photo into the conversation. Choose the AI, speech recognition and spoken voice that suit you.

YOUR APPLE APPS, BY VOICE
Ask what is on your Calendar, add a Reminder, find a Contact, control Music or run a Siri Shortcut. Control compatible Home devices through HomeKit. Start Avenkin through Siri, Shortcuts or the Action Button, and use CarPlay for supported in-car actions. You choose the permissions and tools available to your assistant; calls, messages and other actions follow the relevant system confirmation steps.

TALK, READ AND REMEMBER
Ask follow-up questions, hear answers, translate conversations and read text from photos. Keep notes and useful context, then return to your saved conversations. Connect supported services when you need to go further.

CHOOSE YOUR AI
Connect a supported cloud provider, use your own server, or run a compatible model on your device. Apple Intelligence is available on supported devices. Local model downloads, performance, vision and tool support depend on your device and the model you choose. Online services still need a connection.

KEEP YOUR MANUALS
The optional My Manuals Personal subscription lets you save your own PDF, Word (DOC/DOCX) and Markdown manuals, or photograph pages. Select the manuals relevant to a conversation, ask a question by voice and open the cited source page. Read, organise or delete manuals on your device. Word and Markdown create a text reading copy; use PDF to preserve diagrams and page layout.

FOR FIELD WORK
Field Assist adds a separate professional workflow for jobs, procedures, reference material and reports. My Manuals and Field Assist have separate subscriptions and access; one does not unlock the other.

YOUR DATA AND CONNECTIONS
Saved conversations and manual files are kept on your device. When you choose a cloud AI service, the content needed for your request is sent to that service. Review the app's processing information and privacy controls, and choose local engines when you want supported processing on your device.

Some providers require a separate account, subscription or API key and may charge for usage. Avenkin does not include a subscription to a third-party AI service. Optional in-app subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through your Apple Account. Any free trial is available only to eligible subscribers; the purchase screen shows your local price and offer.

AI can make mistakes. Check answers against the source material and use appropriate professional judgement.

reviewNotes:
Avenkin is a phone/tablet AI assistant. No smart glasses or other external hardware are required.

APP STORE / TESTFLIGHT DIFFERENCE
The App Store installation disables smart-glasses functionality. The Meta Wearables SDK is never initialised and glasses controls are hidden. The same uploaded binary retains glasses functionality when installed through TestFlight. Bluetooth usage descriptions remain because linked Meta frameworks reference CoreBluetooth. Please assess the App Store installation as a phone-only app.

GETTING STARTED
There is no Avenkin account or app sign-in. Complete onboarding and choose an AI in Settings > AI Models. On a supported device with Apple Intelligence enabled, select Apple Intelligence to try the assistant without a third-party account or API key. Alternatively, download a compatible local model using the local-model settings. External AI providers and self-hosted services are optional and use the user's own credentials. Tap Type to ask a question, or grant microphone permission and use Tap & Talk. Phone-camera features do not need glasses.

APPLE APP INTEGRATION
Calendar and Reminders use EventKit, Contacts uses Contacts, compatible Home control uses HomeKit, and music controls and Siri Shortcuts are available through tools. The app requests the relevant system permissions; reviewers may decline optional permissions and continue. Calls and messages use iOS confirmation/composer flows. Siri and the Action Button can invoke the app through its App Intents. These features require an AI model that supports the relevant tools; external services need the user's own setup.

MY MANUALS (PERSONAL IN-APP SUBSCRIPTION)
Open Settings > My Manuals. Upload manual > Choose PDF, Word or Markdown opens the system file picker before purchase. A preview shows the selected file. A verified Personal subscription is required to save/index it and ask source-cited questions. Photograph pages is also available. Manuals can be selected for a conversation and deleted from the library. Publisher links/codes are an alternative import route under Upload manual. PDF retains the source page layout; Word/Markdown retain the original plus a labelled text reading copy. Users provide their own manuals and are responsible for having permission to use them. No manufacturer workshop PDF is bundled. The attached review kit contains original fictional Markdown manuals for testing. Current allowance: five manuals, up to 8,000 pages each and 10,000 pages in total. Product: com.openglasses.my_manuals_monthly, one month, with a one-week introductory free trial for eligible subscribers. Use Restore purchases to restore verified access.

SEPARATE PROFESSIONAL ACCESS
Field Assist and Medical Compliance are separate optional services. A Personal purchase does not grant their access, and a Field Assist purchase does not grant Personal access. My Manuals does not require Field Assist to be enabled.

The interface has been exercised on iPhone Air (iOS 27.2) and iOS simulators. Local AI capabilities depend on device/model support. No clinical or safety-critical decision should rely on an unchecked AI answer.
